Class SimpleSerialServerSocket

java.lang.Object
com.sgware.serialsoc.SerialServerSocket
com.sgware.serialsoc.SimpleSerialServerSocket
All Implemented Interfaces:
CheckedRunnable, AutoCloseable, Callable<Void>
Direct Known Subclasses:
SecureSerialServerSocket
public class SimpleSerialServerSocket extends SerialServerSocket
A SerialServerSocket that uses a ServerSocket to accept basic Sockets, reads and writes to those sockets using text, and separates incoming and outgoing messages with new line characters.
Author:
Stephen G. Ware

    • connect

      protected void connect() throws IOException
      Description copied from class: SerialServerSocket
      Binds the server socket to its network port. It runs after SerialServerSocket.onStart() on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run(). If this method does not throw an exception, SerialServerSocket.onConnect(), SerialServerSocket.onClose(), SerialServerSocket.disconnect(), and SerialServerSocket.onDisconnect() are guaranteed to run before the server stops.
      Specified by:
      connect in class SerialServerSocket
      Throws:
      IOException

    • accept

      protected Socket accept() throws IOException
      Description copied from class: SerialServerSocket
      Blocks until a new socket connects to the server and then returns it. This method does not run on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run(). Once this method returns a socket, it does not run again until after SerialServerSocket.create(Socket) and SerialServerSocket.onAccept(SerialSocket) have finished processing the socket. If this method throws an exception, the server closes.
      Specified by:
      accept in class SerialServerSocket
      Returns:
      a newly accepted socket
      Throws:
      IOException

    • create

      protected SimpleSerialSocket create(Socket socket) throws IOException
      Description copied from class: SerialServerSocket
      Creates a SerialSocket from a Socket. This method is called after SerialServerSocket.accept() but on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run(). If this method throws an exception, the socket will be closed; otherwise, SerialServerSocket.onAccept(SerialSocket) will be called after.
      Specified by:
      create in class SerialServerSocket
      Parameters:
      socket - the socket to make into a serial socket
      Returns:
      a serial socket
      Throws:
      IOException

    • disconnect

      protected void disconnect() throws IOException
      Description copied from class: SerialServerSocket
      Disconnects the server from the network such that it can no longer accept any new connections. This method should cause SerialServerSocket.accept() to stop blocking if it is waiting. This method runs after SerialServerSocket.onClose() on the same thread that called SerialServerSocket.run(), but only if the server successfully connected. It is possible the server is already disconnected from the network by the time this method runs if a network error is what caused the server to close.
      Specified by:
      disconnect in class SerialServerSocket
      Throws:
      IOException
